review_scope: One pinned upstream parent/fixed source pair; source-level only
root_cause: The parent TryInlineReflectApply sends the ReflectApply result GateRef to ReplaceGateWithPendingException. The parent helper classifies the exception path by comparing that value with ExceptionConstant; the fixed helper instead branches on HasPendingException(glue_). This supports a local source-level hypothesis that the return sentinel is not a reliable proxy for thread pending-exception state.

evidence.claim: The ReflectApply return value reaches the shared helper unchanged.
Parent helper compares value with ExceptionConstant, branches on the equality, and wires successor state into replacement.
Fixed helper uses HasPendingException(glue_) and keeps the exception/success state replacement wiring.

protections.condition: HasPendingException(glue_) controls the same helper branch in the fixed source.

missing_evidence: Binding either upstream revision to a shipped product/version/branch and its exact build profile
Proof the native-inline path is enabled in that product build
A product-reachable Reflect.apply entry with attacker-controlled inputs
recommended_next_check: Replay the verified parent/fixed raw blobs through D1 with actual identity facts; expect parent candidate and fixed no same-rule candidate without labeling fixed safe.
Add wrong blob/revision and adjacent safe-helper controls, then independently rerun the tests.
Keep product vulnerability and product safety unknown until product build, reachability, and impact evidence close.
limitations: This assessment is a source-level inference from the parent/fixed mechanism and their source diff.
No product build, runtime test, or PoC was run.
The helper is shared by other callers; this review does not classify every caller.
The detector's structural relationship checks are not general CFG dominance or product applicability proofs.
